audit.description: What happened, who allowed it, under what authority, and what it cost.
audit.retentionLine: control-plane events retained 7 years · run ledger not recorded · bodies {bodies} · {org}

tiles.label: Summary
tiles.eventsNote: every IAM decision is recorded, allowed or not
tiles.deniedNote: denials are recorded and cost nothing

events.title: Control-plane events
events.caption: admin actions, IAM changes, repo bindings, plane changes, key rotations
events.searchPlaceholder: Search events, receipts, actors, external ids
events.searchNotRecorded: Search is not recorded yet. The audit read takes no text query, so use the Actor, Range and Result filters.
events.severityNotRecorded: An audit event records no severity yet.
events.none: No events in this window match these filters.
events.note: The record is written by the kernel, never by an agent. A client-attested call is labeled as such and can never be shown as decided by Oxagen.
events.actorKindNotRecorded: An audit event records no actor kind yet, so Humans, Agents and Services cannot be picked.

csv.title: Export events
csv.subtitle: CSV · the same rows the API and MCP return
csv.body: The file holds the events this table reads over the same actor, range and result, with the event id, actor, capability, result, workspace, IP address, user agent and request id. It is signed with HMAC-SHA256 and the signature travels in the response headers. Nothing in a control-plane event is a prompt or tool body, so this export carries no redaction step.

bundle.title: Export an evidence bundle
bundle.subtitle: segments, attestations, key ids, and the verifier
bundle.fieldsNotRecorded: export_data takes no range or format yet. It exports the whole organization as one ZIP.
bundle.callout: Runs as <c>export_data</c>, a governed action with third-party egress.
bundle.notRecorded: The ZIP carries no verifier yet. The signed segment bundle with attestations, key ids and the verifier is not built for the organization.
bundle.denied: Only an organization owner or admin can export the organization. Nothing was queued.
bundle.pending: The export waits on access request {id}.
bundle.failed: The export was not queued. The control plane answered {code}.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.caption: raised by the policy engine, the gateway and the verifier
incidents.notRecorded: Incidents are not listed for the organization yet. The incident read answers one workspace at a time, and no write opens, assigns or resolves an incident.

incident.title: Open an incident
incident.subject: Subject
incident.notRecorded: No write opens an incident yet. The collector and the control plane record incidents they detect, and nothing records one a person raises.

receipts.title: Receipt search
receipts.caption: one signed record per tool call
receipts.searchPlaceholder: agent key, tool, external effect id, call digest, receipt id
receipts.notRecorded: Receipts are not recorded yet. No store holds a signed receipt per tool call, so there is nothing to search.

exports.callout: An export is a verifiable bundle: archive segments, attestations, key ids, and a verifier script. The segment was written at seal time, so it is never a later copy of the graph. It is the same bytes the graph indexed, written once. A customer’s auditor checks it offline, without trusting Oxagen or the worker’s harness.
exports.notRecorded: No store lists the organization's evidence bundles yet. Build bundle queues the organization's data export as a ZIP through export_data, and the export it queued shows here. A signed evidence bundle with its verifier is built per run today, not for the organization.
exports.verifyNotRecorded: A ZIP data export carries no seal signatures, so there is nothing to verify.
exports.unread: Export {id} could not be read. The control plane answered {code}.
exports.verifierNotRecorded: The offline verifier ships inside a run's evidence bundle. No organization-wide bundle is built yet, so none is shown here.
exports.outboundNotRecorded: No outbound event subscription is recorded. Nothing names the event kinds, the dead-letter view or the delivery.

keys.title: Keys
keys.notRecorded: Keys are not recorded yet. No store lists the organization's key-encryption key, its generations or the signing keys receipts cite.

rotate.title: Rotate the key-encryption key
rotate.subtitle: a new generation, nothing rewritten

facts.effectValue: immediately for new bodies, segments and subject keys
facts.oldValue: becomes retiring and stays valid for decryption until re-wrap completes
facts.receiptsValue: keep citing the signing generation they were signed under, so an old receipt still verifies
facts.recordedValue: <c>key.rotated</c> with who, when and the generation

rotate.notRecorded: No write rotates a key-encryption key yet, because no key registry exists to hold the next generation.

retention.title: Retention
retention.notRecorded: The hot window, replay of a compacted run and each workspace's opt-down are not recorded yet. No read carries them.
retention.tiersNotRecorded: No read lists the archive tiers, where each is held or how much each holds today.
retention.redactionNote: The collector redacts credential shapes before a frame body is written. Each removal is recorded with the digest of the bytes removed, so a redacted body still verifies against its digest.
retention.coldValue: {gb} GB held past the included {months} months

policy.title: Retention policy
policy.subtitle: organization-wide
policy.callout: Shortening the hot window compacts frame rows sooner and saves database cost. It does not touch bodies, and replay of a compacted run reads the segment at the same grade.
policy.notRecorded: No write saves a retention policy yet. The hot window has no store, and the body retention is read from the pinned policy but cannot be changed here.

empty.title: No audit events yet
empty.body: Control-plane audit events are written by the kernel on every governed action. An empty record means nothing has been done in this organization yet, not that recording is off.

error.title: Audit could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered <c>{status} {code}</c>. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.trace: trace not recorded · region not recorded · {at}

denied.title: You cannot see the audit record
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.

request.title: Request access
request.notRecorded: No write sends an access request yet. Ask an organization owner to grant the role, and the grant lands in the audit record.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Access request {id} is waiting for an owner's decision.
